logic.description: Implemented (2026-10-29, alt leg reworked 2026-10-30). Delta damage (Space) + 1 lost action on one enemy in contact. With nobody in reach the alt leg fires: a RANDOM effect card out of the Dimension Library (every peer picks the same; nothing leaves my hand) is laid as an enter-trap (power 20 per element) on a random free known tile within 10 hexes. Whoever deals with that trap (takes its damage, or a Cleric disables it with someone on the tile) gets the card in THEIR discard pile (library: true).

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Rule 21 (pc): Σ over the cast elements of max(caster stat − defender stat, 0), ÷10, rounded half up; a Force Shield die is subtracted from the Σ before rounding (peer side).
The hit target loses its next 1 action; doubled on a ∀ double cast (Rule 23).
Nobody in reach: a random library card as an enter-trap on a random free tile within 10 hexes.
When the trap springs: Σ over its elements of max(0, 20 − victim stat) ÷10 rounded half up (the same shields / zones / Void as a cast apply).

User ruling 2026-10-30: a trap under its owner goes back to the OWNER's discard pile; a trap on an unoccupied tile (enter trigger) goes to the discard pile of the unit that dealt with it (sprang it, or a Cleric with someone on the tile). Library-generated traps only ever exist as that card for the one who dealt with them.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_space (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
